title: Organic Opportunity Map
summary: Turn search demand, current SERPs and inspected site content into prioritised decisions about which pages to improve or create.
outcome: A sourced page-action queue with commercial fit, current page ownership, concrete edits, rejected topics and a complete research receipt.
boundary: The Skill does not promise rankings, treat sampled keyword absence as proof of a gap, publish content, change a website or expand beyond the approved market and sample sizes.

catalog_tools.purpose: Sample the target and selected competitors' ranked keywords in one market.
Find search competitors when the user has not supplied suitable domains.
Validate demand, difficulty, intent and SERP-feature signals for shortlisted topics.
Check current intent, result pages and target page ownership.
Inspect the target and rival pages behind each recommendation.
Recover main content when the first extraction is incomplete; use only when needed and within budget.

inputs: Business objective, audience and any excluded topics
outputs: Prioritised update/create/hold page decisions with concrete edits and acceptance checks
Claim-to-source ledger and complete research receipt

cost.model: Bounded domain samples and keyword validation, current SERPs and selected page extraction.
cost.notes: Plan from inspected prices including result charges and retries. Small default: three 100-row domain samples, ten validated topics, six searches and six pages; fewer outputs if evidence is insufficient.

approvals: Use existing authorisation for the business, market, bounded selection rules and total maximum; obtain missing approval before spending
Pause for a server confirmation request or a material scope or budget expansion
No publishing or website writes without explicit scope
compatibility: One authorized Scrollport connection with apps, discover, inspect, run and wallet
A local file or conversation state for the checkpoint and final map
